notes: NeoForge's success path makes two `try? FileManager.default.removeItem` calls (lines 130-131): the installer jar, then `serverDir/installer.log`. `ForgeInstaller.install` only removes the jar (see forge-installer-cleanup-removes-jar-only) -- a real asymmetry between the two installers, not a porting mistake to silently unify. The Rust port (P7.14) should keep whatever cleanup set is per-flavor rather than assuming a single shared cleanup list.
